When found in Control Head / Multi Media Interface (MMI), check Adaptasyon / Kalibrasyon Yapın:  Channel 012 (Telephone Type) for Plausibility.

When found in Brake Electronics (MK60EC1):
Replacing the Brake Electronics Control Module (J104) but keeping the (old) Hydraulics Unit will result in the Intake and Disconnecting Valves not being synchronized. A  Basic Setting for the Intake/Disconnecting Valves will solve this problem.
When found in the  Audi A4 (8H) Automatic Roof perform the Adaptasyon / Kalibrasyon Yapın:  and see the VAG Grubu Özel Servis ve Kronik Notları.
When found in Audi A3/S3 (8P): Instrument Cluster:
Kontrol edin: /Perform Instrument Cluster Service Interval Settings (Adaptasyon / Kalibrasyon Yapın:  Channels 42, 43, 44, 45 and 49)   E?ID=135368 
When found in any other Audi Instrument Custer run and save an Adaptasyon / Kalibrasyon Yapın:  Function Control Module Map.  After doing so try resetting ALL (see note) applicable service resets using the [SRI Reset] function in VCDS. If the issue is not resolved run/save another Adaptasyon / Kalibrasyon Yapın:  Function Control Module Map so the stored values can be compared.
